scripts.text: ^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming is not considered normal and may hinder the instance progress.^000000

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Will you come back to me after getting a little bit stronger? How about getting to level 100 first?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Ah, no, I didn't meant to go inside. I didn't meant to violate any laws.
What are you talking about?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Ha?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Hmm, are you one of the Royal Palace's suppression squad?
I'm an ordinary adventurer.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Phew~ That's a relief.
I've never soon you before, so I thought you are one of the suppression squad of the palace.
What if I am one of the suppression squad?
What's the matter?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
I'm just an ordinary woman who's out for a walk. And this is the end of my walk, and I'm going to...

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Have you heard about the Paros Lighthouse collapse?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
^777700(She moved close to me)^000000
The Paros Lighthouse here collapsed for some unknown reason some time ago, and there's a lot of stuff underneath it.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Some of the restoration workers and guards that were sent to the palace went missing. Rumors has it that monsters are crawling down there.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Because its depth is seemingly endless, the people here became afraid of this place and started calling it Infinite Space.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
I know some people who sneaked in and made a fortune. That's why I'm going to give it a try, are you interested?
I'm not interested.
Yes.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
That's unfortunate. Come back whenever you change your mind. I'll welcome you anytime.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
All right, Just one thing, I'm inexperienced and a novice adventurer. So I'll help you explore down there by guiding you from somewhere safe.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
I'm an adventure tour, and you can explore it yourself. Aren't we compatible with each other? Then, let's get started when you're ready.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Are you going in there again this time?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Oh, your whole body is shouting that it's tired. You can't go down there like this.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
It's impossible alone. Would you like to organize a party at least one person or join another party and come back?
Prepare to enter Infinite Space
Cancel

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Once the passage opens, take a breath for a while and talk to me again.
The passage is not yet activated.
The passage is not yet activated.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
I have went in and out of this place many times and figured out a way to provoke the monsters in here. You can get more rewards if you're going to deal with heated ones.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
What do you think? Would you like to try something challenging?
I want to proceed normally
I want to proceed with something difficult

[ Reckless Explorer ]
Good. Shall we go now?

[ Reckless Explorer ]
I'll keep a separate record of this expedition. If you've been lucky, you might have gotten a decent reward from your expedition.

[ Reckless Explorer ]
So, shall we get out of here?
